name: card
description: A structured container for self-contained, independently meaningful blocks of information. Built on shadcn Card — purely presentational, no Radix primitive. A shell that owns surface, border, radius, and padding; content is freely composed inside.

Property 1.notes: These are example compositions — demonstrations of content types inside the shell, not a closed set of modes. In practice, card interiors are assembled freely from card-header, card-content, card-footer, and slot frames.

intent.Form: card-header + input fields + card-footer with buttons. Use for login, sign-up, settings forms.
intent.Action: card-header + single footer action button. Use for confirmation prompts, upgrade nudges.
intent.Info: card-header + content slots + description + avatar group. Use for metric panels, dashboard summaries.
intent.Social media: card-header with avatar + follow button + image + slots. Use for social feed items.
intent.Image-vertical: Full-width image at top + slots + content + action buttons. Use for product listings.
intent.Image-down: Slots + content + full-width image at bottom. Use when text leads and image provides context below.
intent.Image-horizontal: Square image left + slots + title + action. Use for compact product cards, search results.
intent.Border: card-header + slots with color/border/strong stroke. Use to emphasise highlighted/selected/featured cards.
intent.Tab: tab-list at top + card-header + slots. Use for switchable metric views.
intent.Item: card-header + slots + item rows + avatar group. Use for list-style cards (settings, team members).

container.paddingNote: 16px default (data/dashboard density). Pass spacing/component/xl (24px) for prose/feature cards, spacing/component/md (12px) for dense. See Card Layout ground rules.

tokens.imagePaddingNote: Image-vertical, Image-down, Image-horizontal have NO root padding — image bleeds edge-to-edge. padding applies inside card-content only.

slots.Slot 1: Free-composition FRAME — charts, stat blocks, image frames, badge rows
slots.Slot 2: Free-composition FRAME — charts, stat blocks, image frames, badge rows

subComponents.CardHeader: V AUTO-LAYOUT — title + description. Maps to <CardHeader> + <CardTitle> + <CardDescription>.
subComponents.CardContent: V AUTO-LAYOUT — interior content: fields, text, item rows, etc. Maps to <CardContent>.
subComponents.CardFooter: H AUTO-LAYOUT — primary action buttons, avatars. Maps to <CardFooter>.

composition.shellModel: Card owns surface, border, radius, padding, and vertical rhythm. All interior content is independently composed.
composition.imageBleeds: For Image variants, apply overflow:hidden and rounded-lg to the card in code so image respects card radius at the bleed edge.

behavior.architecture: Purely presentational — no Radix primitive, no state, no interactivity.
behavior.noBuiltInState: Card has no hover, focus, active, or selected state. For interactive cards, wrap in <button> or <a> and add Tailwind utilities for state.
behavior.flexibleComposition: CardHeader, CardContent, CardFooter are not all required — mix and match per variant.

accessibility.role: No implicit role — renders as <div>. Add role='article' for feed items, role='region' + aria-label for landmark sections.
accessibility.interactiveCards: Wrap in <button> or <a> — give accessible name via aria-label or visible heading.
accessibility.cardTitle: <CardTitle> renders as <div> — promote to <h2>/<h3> via asChild when card is a content section.
accessibility.imageAlt: All card images need alt — descriptive for content images, alt='' for decorative.

constraints: Use cards only when content is independently meaningful — a metric, product, profile, or setting category.
Do not wrap every page section in cards — creates visual noise without hierarchy.
Always include card-header with at least a title — a card with no heading is not scannable.
Keep fill as color/surface/overlay — the card's elevated surface relative to the page is intentional.
Do not put a card inside a card — use item rows inside card-content instead.
Property 1=Border signals selection or emphasis — reserve it for one highlighted card in a set.
Image-bleed variants require overflow:hidden in code to clip the image at the card's radius/lg corners.

useCases: Dashboard metric panels showing a headline stat, supporting description, and a trend sparkline
E-commerce product listings with an image, title, price, and add-to-cart action
Authentication forms (login, sign-up, password reset) contained in a centred card shell
User profile summaries combining avatar, name, role, and quick-action buttons
Settings category panels grouping related input fields under a titled section
Social feed post previews with avatar, username, image, and engagement actions

Form.whenToUse: The card collects structured user input

Action.whenToUse: The card presents a single decision or call-to-action

Info.whenToUse: The card summarises a metric or status with supporting context

Social media.whenToUse: The card is a social content preview with identity and media

Image-vertical.whenToUse: The image is the primary hook and leads the card content

Image-down.whenToUse: Text leads, image provides supporting context below

Image-horizontal.whenToUse: Image and text share equal weight in a compact format

Border.whenToUse: One card in a set needs visual emphasis (selected, featured, highlighted plan)

Tab.whenToUse: The card presents multiple switchable views of the same content

Item.whenToUse: The card groups a list of row entries under a titled section

comparedTo.situation: A self-contained block of independent information (metric, product, profile)
A single repeatable row in a list (one entry among many)
Structured tabular data with sortable columns and many uniform rows
A generic section wrapper for every page region

notes: Card variants are example compositions, not closed modes — any interior structure is valid as long as the shell tokens are preserved.

changelog.change: Default padding reduced from spacing/component/xl (24px) to spacing/component/lg (16px) — 24px read as over-padded on data/dashboard cards. 16px is now the data/default density; override to xl (24px) for prose/feature cards. Per Card Layout ground rules in agentic-design-system.md.

darkMode.notes: No known dark mode differences — all tokens are semantic and mode-aware.
